title: Undertow and Language
author: O. M. Thackeray
blurb: Xanthe Yarrow, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
